semantic_end.speaker: Narrator
semantic_end.text: The route closes because Mira's knowledge profile perceived a mismatch in [receipt_fragment.credibility], created a concrete perception event, and changed what [receipt_fragment] means. The ending depends on character perception plus event presence, not on collecting enough evidence points.
